## Publication review

- [ ] I have the right to publish every included text, image, dataset, and citation.
- [ ] Sources, creators, licenses, and required attribution are recorded accurately.
- [ ] No confidential, private, credential-bearing, or personally sensitive data is included.
- [ ] A human fluent in the target language reviewed every machine-assisted translation.
- [ ] Existing public URLs remain stable, or an intentional redirect/tombstone preserves each one.
- [ ] The correct CODEOWNERS approved: `@mjdiloreto` for repository changes and `@ecdecker` for content, Box snapshots, or bibliography data.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run site -- test`
- [ ] `npm run site -- check`
- [ ] `npm run site -- build --base-url https://blog.emilycdecker.com/`
